rationale.conceptual: The task uses a standard DFT method (GGA-PBE, spin polarization, dispersion correction) for adsorption and vibrational frequency calculations. The only variation is building alloy slabs, which is a well-known procedure. No novel algorithms or deep theoretical derivations are required.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises three distinct stages: slab model construction, geometry optimization for multiple initial placements, and frequency calculation. It requires proper setup of Quantum ESPRESSO, selection of pseudopotentials, and generation of input files, all linked sequentially, which constitutes a moderate multi-step workflow.
